m5_feedback.text:
# M5 bounded controller successor — 2026-10-06

**M5 remains open.** The new controller fails local timing and improvement gates.
No new full forecast, matched development backend or protected validation pair was
launched. After direct chat external-transmission authorization, the configured
research model authored a bound interpretation that passed factual review and
recommends stopping production advancement, retaining limited saved-state
diagnostic use only. It does not override failed admission gates or close M5.

The [frozen successor protocol](../evidence/milestone5_control_20261006/protocol.json)
links the stopped matched study and maps the inherited physical, numerical,
classification, useful ordering, economics, repeatability and complete 10 ms gates.
`fixed_backend_transition_validation@2.0.0` and its original thresholds remain;
continuous-solution and step-refinement failures remain separate negative evidence.
The three original protected pair allocations retain six total backend slots.

Saved command divergence was inspected before new solves. At original075 time
0.02 s, full states differ by about 1.33e-15 and projected states by 8.53e-14;
prior warm states differ by 2.70e-13 and tensions by 3.55e-15. They are close,
not bitwise identical. Commands already differ by 0.0474791 N at selected
iterations 5 and 10; substantial state separation appears at 0.03 s. Earlier
complete warm plans were checked instead of assuming all optimizer inputs matched.
Original15's first command difference above the declared 1e-8 N inspection
threshold is much smaller, about 6.63e-8 N at 0.04 s with equal selected iterations.

Five standalone saved-state solves test a predeclared diagnostic work cap of ten
callback iterations, independently of any forecast. On original075 the same
projected state, previous input and complete own warm plan yield iteration 5 under
the timed policy and iteration 10 under the work diagnostic; their command gap is
0.0474791 N. Replacing only the tiny prior-warm differences at the same work cap
changes the command by about 1.74e-12 N. This supports termination behavior as a
local cause, without proving unique causality over the entire task. Original15
selects iteration 22 under timed stopping but initialization under the diagnostic
cap; fixed work does not establish general convergence or feasibility improvement.
Complete local compute spans 6.764–13.444 s, with separately recorded setup.
The historical five-second condition is not an unconditional execution floor.

The single new production-shaped experimental identity is
`controller.gvs_nmpc@8.0.0`: two prediction nodes, at most two IPOPT iterations,
one-second CPU allowance, and feasible-return minimum/budget of 1/5 ms. It
regenerates all short warm states from the supplied candidate measurement, retains
original finite/initial/dynamics/force feasibility checks, and records bounded
previous-command fallback with no safety claim. The stable v7 binding and behavior
remain available. v7 outcomes do not validate changed v8 behavior. The causal
full-state reference resolves the explicit registered controller rather than
silently running v7 for a new binding.

Four complete software input-to-command measurements include projection/world
output, warm preparation, optimization, independent validation, observation
construction and packaging. One-time setup and physics propagation are separate.
The second measurement repeats identical owned inputs with prepared data cached;
it is a cost diagnostic, not a new causal trajectory.

| Development snapshot | Cold software interval | Cached interval | Cached warm preparation | Selected plan |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| original075, 0.02 s | 0.483243 s | 0.441827 s | 0.257033 s | Initialization; zero improvement |
| original15, 0.04 s | 0.570546 s | 0.524445 s | 0.339700 s | Initialization; zero improvement |

All plans satisfy the retained local constraint bound, but all four measurements
miss 10 ms. Optimization alone takes about 0.173–0.175 s. The callback reaches its
millisecond budget after expensive work has already occurred. Actual graph/solver
construction events are retained separately; repeated construction metadata is
not summed as repeated construction. These are software measurements, not hardware
worst-case guarantees. One more arbitrary smaller timer or iteration recipe has
no supported mechanism to remove the observed preparation/first-evaluation cost,
so the unused second version was not spent.

Screening retains diagnostic reference status. The previous full-order v7 method
had failed aggregate accuracy and one falsely feasible holding-speed decision;
its correct raw speed order was not useful admitted screening. Its all-in reuse
cost was 434.031 s against 194.951 s potentially avoided, with zero actual savings.
These outcomes stay historical and do not become evidence for v8. No cheaper
method family was justified after v8's failed local gate. A task-output surrogate
without the required full-state/local numerical evidence cannot replace the
formal predictor. New complete-trajectory accuracy, classifications, ranking and
positive all-in economics are **unmeasured**, rather than passed. No candidate
was eliminated, and actual savings remain zero. No favorable amortization credit
was declared or invented.

The single engineering repair corrected a saved-state timestamp indexing mistake
before numerical work. Initial incorrect diagnostic output and snapshots remain;
the corrected result uses timestamps and the known initial state. Seven initial
focused reporting/controller checks passed; affected dispatch, force-unit rendering
and diagnostic-token checks passed after their changes. No full repository suite or accepted baseline
rerun was used as scientific validation.

New M5 actual charges are **1 provider / 13 workflow / 0 backend / 86.608 s**,
with nine standalone controller updates and zero extra component evaluations,
forecasts, embedded backend updates, workers or subagents. Remaining development
capacity is 11 provider, 87 workflow, 23913.392 s, six forecasts, six backend
attempts, 231 standalone updates and 24 component evaluations. One experimental
version and zero screening families/revisions were used. All three protected
pairs and the independent repeat remain unrun; all six protected backend slots
are preserved. No model correction was needed. Interpretation and factual-review
cost are included in the same grant; no positive economics are claimed. The
development scope is sealed as a negative result, while M5 remains open.

The next technical decision is a distinct approximation/reuse algorithm that
reduces warm preparation and first derivative/callback work while earning fresh
feasibility, dynamics and closed-loop evidence. The current bounded outcome does
not authorize silently opening a new method family or scientific campaign.

See [corrected saved diagnosis](../evidence/milestone5_control_20261006/saved_diagnosis_corrected.json),
[local intervention](../evidence/milestone5_control_20261006/local_original075_deterministic_forecast.json),
[v8 measurement](../evidence/milestone5_control_20261006/measure8_original075.json),
[development admission decision](../evidence/milestone5_control_20261006/development_assessment.json),
and [accounting](../evidence/milestone5_control_20261006/accounting.json).

The [actual model-authored interpretation](../evidence/milestone5_control_20261006/rendered_interpretation0.md),
[factual review](../evidence/milestone5_control_20261006/interpretation_review0.json)
and [final bounded delivery](../evidence/milestone5_control_20261006/checkpoint_seal.json)
preserve this distinction. Following direct chat authorization, an ordinary push
published the completed checkpoints, with the remote verified at
`9963f535445a50ecd1d6db30f05ab41cc03e0218`. The separate
[publication verification](../evidence/context_assembly_publication_20261006/published_checkpoint.json)
preserves the earlier automatic-review rejection. Publication did not resume
scientific work; M5 remains open and all six protected backend slots remain unused.

allowed: Compatible bounded historical tensions as numerical guesses only
invalidated: trajectories, evaluation, profiles, acceptance and comparisons
reuse.rule: Exact configuration identity and provenance bind every result; rebuild after relevant edits. Cache/replay is not a repetition.

validation_evidence.scientific_claim: No robustness or closed-loop outcome is inferred from capability.

parameter_catalog.subset_selection: All comparison groups may choose any subset of usable_pool within frozen domains; no per-batch permission.
parameter_catalog.version_rule: Newly connected capability requires a new shared capability/study version.

task_acceptance.authority: tools.research_tasks.assemble_acceptance; unchanged evaluate.reach plus sealed profile/motion.
task_acceptance.historical_protocol: All historical real-time failures retain original labels; new offline acceptance does not rescore sealed historical results.
task_acceptance.requirements: Full execution; finite required signals; terminal reach and both holding components and applied force bounds. Missing evidence is unavailable, not physical infeasibility.
